key_fields.name: WS-CURDATE-DATA
key_fields.meaning: Receives FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE: date CCYYMMDD followed by time HHMMSShh.

key_fields.name: WS-CURDATE-MM-DD-YY
key_fields.meaning: Display date MM/DD/YY moved to the screen header.

key_fields.name: WS-CURTIME-HH-MM-SS
key_fields.meaning: Display time HH:MM:SS moved to the screen header.

key_fields.name: WS-TIMESTAMP
key_fields.meaning: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS.ffffff timestamp layout; not referenced by COACTUPC.

purpose: Defines WS-DATE-TIME, working storage for the current date and time: a raw area that receives FUNCTION CURRENT-DATE, numeric redefinitions, and edited MM/DD/YY, HH:MM:SS and timestamp layouts. COACTUPC uses it only in 3100-SCREEN-INIT to put the current date and time in the screen header.
